environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.20 sidecar injection enabled on both namespaces. An AuthorizationPolicy resource exists in the 'infrastructure' namespace with spec.action DENY for requests where source.namespace is not in ['infrastructure'] AND the request does not carry a valid SPIFFE identity matching spiffe://cluster.local/ns/infrastructure/sa/state-backend-client. Additionally, a PeerAuthentication resource in 'infrastructure' namespace enforces STRICT mTLS mode. However, the AuthorizationPolicy uses a 'when' clause matching on request.headers['x-request-source'] != 'terraform-provider' as an additional condition (OR'd with namespace check), which the attacker's injected metadata DOES satisfy since the code hardcodes x-request-source to 'terraform-provider'. The Envoy sidecar on the state-backend pod strips and re-writes x-caller-identity based on the authenticated SPIFFE identity from the mTLS handshake, but only when the upstream_connection_options.override_metadata annotation is set on the Destination Rule (which it is, with value 'x-caller-identity,x-workspace-id').
